name: Pacific Century Regional Developments Limited
summary: Pacific Century Regional Developments Limited, an investment holding company, provides business management and consultancy services. It holds interests in the telecommunications, media, IT solutions, logistics, and property development and investment businesses in the Asia-Pacific region. The company was formerly known as Seapower Asia Investments Limited and changed its name to Pacific Century Regional Developments Limited in November 1994. The company was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Singapore. Pacific Century Regional Developments Limited is a subsidiary of Pacific Century Group (Cayman Islands) Limited.
